title: prof
name: Nilüfer Çetinkaya Kocadal
spec: Istanbul, 2011
interests: Advanced diagnosis and personalized treatment in gynecologic cancers: A multidisciplinary approach to ovarian (ovary), endometrial (uterine), cervical (cervix), vulvar, and vaginal cancers.
Diagnosis and treatment of ovarian cysts: Follow-up, medical management, and when indicated, minimally invasive surgical approaches for functional and pathological ovarian cysts.
Colposcopy: Advanced evaluation, colposcopic biopsy, and safe surveillance following HPV positivity and abnormal cervical smear results, avoiding unnecessary interventions.

Advanced surgery in recurrent gynecologic cancers: Experienced surgical management of recurrent gynecologic tumors, including heated intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) and pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC) in ovarian cancer.
Fertility-preserving gynecologic oncology: Modern and safe approaches aimed at preserving fertility in appropriately selected patients during cancer treatment.
Preventive gynecology and early diagnosis: Risk assessment, screening programs, and individualized prevention strategies for gynecologic cancers.
Minimally invasive surgical techniques: Laparoscopic and robotic surgery focused on less postoperative pain, faster recovery, and early return to daily life.
Management of benign gynecologic diseases: Patient-centered medical and surgical treatment of uterine fibroids, endometriosis, and abnormal uterine bleeding.
Urogynecologic procedures: Surgical and non-surgical management of genital prolapse (uterine prolapse) and urinary incontinence.
Menopause management: Evidence-based evaluation of menopausal symptoms with individualized treatment and follow-up to improve quality of life.
